correctness.rationale: Binary prefix-normal words with exactly 7 ones correspond to positive minimum gap a, trailing zeros ℓ≥0 and integer offsets x,y,z,t,v≥0 satisfying y+z≥x, z+t≥x, t+v≥x and z+t+v≥x+y. This produces a pointed 5D rational cone. Independent determinant enumeration checked all 9 choose 4 hyperplane intersections, recovered exactly 13 primitive rays with degrees 1,1,1,2,2,2,3,3,4,4,4,6,6 (sum39). Standard simplicial half-open triangulation/fundamental-parallelepiped bounds give polynomial numerator degree≤39 after multiplying by all ray binomials D(z). Independently enumerated integer points and verified exact D*G=K*H coefficientwise through degree48, including all 40 required coefficients; H has coefficients [1,3,9,17,35,48,76,85,108,103,108,85,76,48,35,17,9,3,1]. Cancellation yields z^7H/((1-z)(1-z^3)(1-z^4)^2(1-z^6)^3). Primitive fourth and sixth poles persist because H mod Φ4=z, H mod Φ6=1, forcing least quasiperiod lcm(4,6)=12 on n≥7; order7 pole at1 gives 289/2488320 n^6 leading term. Independently enumerated all seven-one words at n=7..19 and confirmed generating-function coefficients; finite computation covers the cone coefficient certificate, not an unchecked asymptotic inference.
